name: Gad Dairies Marketing 1992 Ltd.
summary: Gad Dairies (Marketing 1992) Ltd. engages in the provision of dairy products. The firm's products include yogurts, desserts, delicacies, and Italian, Balkan and local, special, and New York cream cheeses. It operates through the Retail Sector and Professional Sector segments. The Retail Sector segment is involved in entering agreements with national food chains, regional chains and supermarkets, and retailers. The Professional Sector segment offers its products as raw materials to restaurants, nationwide food chains, pizzerias, delicatessens, hotels, cafes, and coffee carts. The company was founded by Ezra Gad Cohen on December 17, 1992 and is headquartered in Bat Yam, Israel.
